notes.title: Recent bug fixes - Japanese task fixes
notes.content:
[h1] Japanese mission BUG fixed[/h1]

[i] "We have received feedback from players who speak Japanese that the task of building a farm cannot be completed normally. After verification, this problem was caused by localization translation conflicts and has now been fixed. Thank you to the players who provided feedback on this problem. The production team deeply apologizes for the inconvenience this has caused to players. Since localization is still in its early stages, if you encounter similar problems again, please feel free to provide feedback to the discussion forum. Thank you for your support!"[/i]

Change 1: Fixed a BUG that caused the farm task to not be completed normally when the language was Japanese.

notes.title: Recent bug fixes - new archive store price reset
notes.content:
[h1]Store prices are reset normally[/h1]

[i] "We have received feedback from players that when exiting from an old save and creating a new one, the prices in the store are still the same as those in the old save. Now that we have fixed this BUG, players can create saves normally and start a new game at any time. Or start the second game."[/i]

[h3] Change 1: Fixed a BUG that caused the store price not to be reset when the player opened a new save[/h3]


[h3] If you encounter any problems in the game, please leave a message in the discussion area. We will continue to pay attention to and improve the game. Thank you for your support~[/h3]

tags.bug: Change 1: Fixed a BUG that caused the store price not to be reset when the player opened a new save

notes.title: New features added and recent bug fixes - keyboard control movement/Japanese tas
notes.content:
[h1]New function added - keyboard controlled perspective movement[/h1]

[i]"We received suggestions from some players that moving the camera using just the mouse is too cumbersome, so we added the ability to use the keyboard to control the camera, and subsequently changed the shortcut keys for selling cards."[/i]

Change 1: Now you can use the keyboard's "WASD" and arrow keys to control the movement of the game perspective
Change 2: The shortcut key for selling cards has been changed from the original "S" to "F"

[h1] Japanese mission BUG fixed[/h1]

[i] "We have received feedback from players who speak Japanese that the task of building a lumberyard cannot be completed normally. After verification, this problem was caused by localization translation conflicts and has been fixed. Thanks to the players who gave feedback on this problem, The production team deeply apologizes for the trouble this has caused to players. Since localization is still in its early stages, if you encounter similar problems again, please feel free to provide feedback to the discussion forum. Thank you for your support!"[/i]

Change 3: Fixed a BUG that caused the lumberyard mission to not be completed properly when the language was Japanese.

Change 2: The shortcut key for selling cards has been changed from the original "S" to "F"

notes.title: Game experience optimization update for new players
notes.content:
[h1]Add "Game Guide" window to novice teaching mode[/h1]

[i] "We are committed to improving the gaming experience for all types of players. Although there are play guidelines for "Card Age" on the game store page GIFs, live demonstration videos, and in-game help interfaces, there are still Some players who focus on the game feel confused when they first enter the game and don't know how to start the game, so we have forced the "Game Guide" window into the novice tutorial mode."[/i]

Change 1: Novice tutorial mode - display "Game Guide" at the beginning
Change 2: Novice teaching mode - In this mode, a "?" button is added in the upper right corner of the game, so you can view the "Game Guide" again at any time

[i] "There are many interesting mechanisms and techniques in the game waiting for players to explore, such as "how to quickly obtain currency", "how to organize cards to make the desktop tidier", "how to build an assembly line to make mechanical and complex manual operations "Becoming simple" and "How to avoid combat affecting the previous card layout". We expect players to discover and solve these problems on their own, which is also the core charm of the game."[/i]


[h1] When logging in to the game for the first time, it automatically identifies and sets the game language[/h1]

[i] "We have received feedback from some players that although the game language can be switched on the "Settings" page of the game's main menu, some players may not be able to find the button because the initial voice of the game is Simplified Chinese, so we have optimized Language switching mechanism when logging into the game for the first time."[/i]

Change 3: System - when logging in to the game for the first time, automatically switches the game language to the language set by the player in Steam

If you have logged into the game before this update, the automatic language switching function may not be triggered. Please click the "Gear" button in the game's main menu to open the game settings interface and switch languages.

[h2]Update instructions[/h2]
This update has been installed before the start of the New Product Festival and will not affect any previous game saves.
